notes: Supplied study/outcome/test locators and neutral description were empty. The primary replication report identifies a unique focal claim (Mini-K and total psychopathology, controlling for age), used to locate the original Table 5 test. Original requested Cohen's f^2 is not printed for this test; printed partial correlation retained without conversion. Original p is the printed significance bound from Table 5, supported by section 3.2.2 stating significant associations for both life history measures, not an exact p. Original title and DOI verified against repository accepted manuscript. Replication final pooled stage 2 selected; stage 1 is interim. Replication also prints ƒ2 = .16 for the same final test. Original authors report complete-measure final sample; no separate test-specific exclusions indicated.
